persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Joseph Kamau, 62, a retired teacher in Nyeri. Your children and nephews in Nairobi play a Formula 1 picking game every race weekend on their phones, and your nephew Alex runs it (he is the “commissioner”). The family wants you to join, they want the league to carry the family name, and the teasing has already started.

lines: This video explains Pit Wall from the very beginning. If you have never seen it, that is fine.
The problem: lots of friend groups run a fantasy Formula One league on a WhatsApp group. One person, the commissioner, collects picks, counts drives in an exercise book, and adds up points by hand.
Until someone misses a text, or the math is off by a point.
Pit Wall does the commissioner's job: picks with a real deadline, scoring done for you, and standings everyone sees on their own phone.

A quick word on Formula One: about twenty drivers race fast cars around a track, most weekends from March to December. The better a driver finishes, the more points he gets. In this game, each player owns a few drivers and scores their points.
It is for friends or family who already play, and especially the commissioner, who finally gets to watch the race.
What you see here is a pretend league: five made-up players and made-up points. Look around freely. Nothing here is real.
At the top: the league name and the season. Until your group connects a shared mailbox, it says this device only.
This button is your name. In a real league you tap it, choose who you are, and set a PIN of four to six digits, so nobody else can enter your picks.
Along the bottom are seven tabs: Home, Standings, Usage, Races, Live, Paddock and Setup.
Home starts with the last race: the podium, and who in your group scored most.
Then the race weekend card: the next Grand Prix, its session times, and exactly when picks are due, in your own time zone.
Each player has a set of drivers, four to start with. Before the deadline you tap two to run this weekend, then tap Send my picks. Each driver shows how many drives he has left.
A couple of times a season you can play a wild card instead: all your drivers in one race, without using any drives.
Miss the deadline and the house rule steps in: it runs your two highest-placed drivers who still have drives. Same rule for everyone.
In this pretend league, Test drive lets you act as any player with one tap, to see the app the way they would.
Lower down: the standings, and last year's champion.
The Standings tab has the season table, and race by race, every player's points for every race.
Results come in by themselves. Tap any race for the driver-by-driver breakdown and a results post for the WhatsApp group.
The Usage tab counts every driver's drives left, and each player's wild cards. The bookkeeping that used to live in a notebook.
Races is the whole season calendar: each race, its pick deadline, and whether it is open, scored or canceled.
On race day, once your league's mailbox is connected, the Live tab shows the running order and what everyone would score if the race ended now.
The Paddock is the group chat for trash talk — friendly teasing about each other's drivers. It was always the best part.
Setup is the commissioner's room. In the pretend league, Start my own league comes first: it asks your league's name and your first name, and the pretend league goes away.
Below that: the shared mailbox, the season, scoring, the draft room, rosters, a starting point if you join mid-season, and players.
Once a year the draft room builds every team: draw a snake order, and everyone picks drivers in turn until the rosters are full.
Your first few minutes: act as one player, read the weekend card, then tap Start my own league in Setup when ready.
Privacy: no account and no ads. Your league lives on this device until your group connects its own free Google mailbox, so the data stays with your league.
And the question mark button in the corner has the tour, bigger text and help, any time.
The app was made in America, so the pretend players have American names: Alex, Bea, Cal, Dana and Eli. In the test, you will add a Kenyan player yourself.

challenge.intro: You will use Pit Wall’s pretend league (Alex, Bea, Cal, Dana and Eli). The race dates and points come from the real F1 season, so no job asks about them. Nobody will tell you which button to press. Use what you learned. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open Pit Wall with the normal link (it ends in ?test=1). If the welcome card shows, tap 'skip the tour' → '🧪 Keep the examples to play with'. If it does not show, scroll to the very bottom of the page and tap '🧹 Start fresh — erase this app’s data' → OK → OK. If the welcome card comes back, tap 'skip the tour' → '🧪 Keep the examples to play with'. The top now says 'PRETEND LEAGUE', and the Paddock card says 'Quiet in here'. (Verified 20 Oct: all four checks false after this.)

tasks.text: Acting as Alex, the commissioner, add yourself to the league: Joseph Kamau.
tasks.hint: Under 'TEST DRIVE · ACT AS' tap Alex. Then Setup → 'Players & league' → the 'Add a player' box → Add.

tasks.text: Still as Alex, rename the league: Kamau Family Racing.
tasks.hint: Setup → 'Players & league' → the 'League name' box → 'Save league name'.

tasks.text: Now act as Bea and post this in the Paddock: My drivers will win in Mexico!
tasks.hint: Tap Bea under 'TEST DRIVE · ACT AS' first (the top-right button then shows Bea). Then Paddock → type in 'Say it…' → Send.

tasks.text: Finally, act as Joseph Kamau and answer her in the Paddock: Habari zenu! Joseph is here.
tasks.hint: Joseph Kamau appears under 'TEST DRIVE · ACT AS' once he is added (go back to 🏁 HOME). Tap his name, then post in the Paddock.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: a family or friends Formula 1 picking game with standings
the commissioner sets up the league and players
everyone picks drivers each race and can trash-talk in the Paddock

daily.task: In Pit Wall, change one pick or one setting for the next race.

explore.name: 🙋 Top bar · your name
explore.try: Tap your name button and pick a name.

explore.name: 🏁 Home · race weekend
explore.try: Tap two drivers. Try the Wild card. Tap Send my picks, then change them with Update my picks.

explore.name: 🎭 Test drive · act as
explore.try: Act as another player, look around, then switch back.

explore.name: 📊 Standings
explore.try: Open Race by race. Tap a race name. Tap 📋 Copy results post. Close.

explore.name: ⛽ Usage
explore.try: Look at drives left. Tap 📋 Copy usage post.

explore.name: 📅 Races · 🔴 Live
explore.try: Look at the calendar and its tags. Open Live.

explore.name: 💬 Paddock
explore.try: Send a short message, a very long one, one with emoji, and try an empty one.

explore.name: ⚙️ Setup
explore.try: Open every card: Season, Scoring, Draft room, Rosters, Starting point, Backfill, Players & league, About & data. Don’t reset this device.

explore.name: ❓ The round ? button
explore.find: Tap the round ? in the bottom corner.
explore.try: Open every line in it: Aa (size), ✨ Ask an AI, 🌉 More from Daraja, 🎬 Take the tour again. Close it. Leave “Start fresh” for the very end.
